visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a pale forearm where a white tissue wipes away a greyish substance, revealing a dark black tattoo of a character. (2) Medium shot of a woman with long dark hair and a white tank top, holding two beige concealer tubes near her face. (3) Sequence showing the woman applying dots and lines of concealer onto her cheeks and forehead using a wand applicator. (4) The woman uses a makeup brush to apply powder from a black compact case onto her face. (5) She holds a black smartphone against her cheek, then pulls it away to show the screen is clean. (6) She presses a pink patterned tissue to her face and lets it fall, showing no makeup residue.
